result.instructions: Tools for Capmo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which tickets in the Riverside project are open and past their deadline?"; "Show me the change orders that are not completed yet and their total cost."; "List the site journals for this week and who was on site each day.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Capmo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run capmo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run capmo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run capmo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. capmo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: capmo_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the projects the API key's user can access, one page at a time. Use it first to find a project id. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects.

source_id.description: Only projects with this source_id (your own external id).

after.description: Cursor from the previous page: pass the `after` value of that response.

tools.name: capmo_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one project: name, address, status phase, client, responsible contact, type, and start and end dates. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}.

project_id.description: The project id (from the list tools).

tools.name: capmo_list_project_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List the tickets (defects, tasks, issues) of one project, one page at a time. Each ticket has name, status, deadline, company, responsible users and cost. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/tickets.

project_id.description: The project id (from the list tools).

after.description: Cursor from the previous page: pass the `after` value of that response.

ticket_id.description: The ticket id (from the list tools).

tools.name: capmo_create_project_ticket
tools.title: Create a ticket
tools.description: Create a ticket in one project. Writes a new record to the customer's Capmo project. Status defaults to OPEN. Capmo API: POST /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/tickets.

project_id.description: The project id (from the list tools).

company_id.description: Project company id responsible for the ticket.

deadline.description: Deadline as a date (yyyy-mm-dd) or a timestamp.

room_listing_id.description: Room listing id to link the ticket to.

source_id.description: Your own external id for this ticket.

tools.name: capmo_update_project_ticket
tools.title: Update a ticket
tools.description: Change fields of one ticket. Only the fields you pass change; send null to clear a nullable field. Capmo API: PATCH /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/tickets/{ticketId}.

project_id.description: The project id (from the list tools).

ticket_id.description: The ticket id (from the list tools).

source_id.description: Your own external id for this ticket.

company_id.description: Project company id responsible for the ticket.

responsible_ids.description: Ids of the responsible users (replaces the list).

deadline.description: Deadline as a date (yyyy-mm-dd) or a timestamp.
